title: Stock counts and transfers
intro: Reconcile physical counts with system stock using adjustments, and move stock between locations with transfers.

sections.title: Adjustments (counts)
steps: Enter counted quantities by item and location.
Submit, approve, and post according to your role so variances update inventory.
sections.caption: Adjustments (stock count) list.

sections.title: Stock transfers
sections.intro: Move stock from one location to another without changing total company quantity.
steps: Choose source and destination locations and transfer lines.
Save to decrease source and increase destination quantities.
sections.caption: Stock transfers tab.
